title: Other taxable income for Self Assessment helpsheet (HS325)
text:
Use the guides and working sheets to work out the figures for the following sections in your tax return:

 • other UK income

 • additional information

 Previous helpsheets can be found on the National Archives website .
changeNote: 'Working sheet 1' and 'Working sheet 2' for income and expenses, along with 'Other taxable Income (HS325)' for tax years 2023 to 2025 have been removed from the page. A link to the National Archives website has been added to the page.
